name: Q-Bench2-HF
description: Q-Bench2-HF is a Hugging Face-hosted benchmark suite for evaluating language models on question-answering and reasoning-style tasks. It collects both multiple-choice and open-ended items across topics to measure factual accuracy, reasoning, and robustness. The dataset is intended for convenient evaluation of model generalization and reliability on standard QA formats.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face with moderate adoption by researchers for quick QA and reasoning evaluations.
